description: This file defines the SequenceLock class implementing lock-free read mechanisms using atomic counters, used for synchronization in concurrent programming within the Abseil library.

classes.name: SequenceLock
classes.description: A class implementing a lock-free sequence lock for concurrent data access, with methods for initialization, reading, writing, and modification counting.

methods.name: AlignUp
methods.description: Aligns a size 'x' up to the nearest multiple of 'align'.

methods.name: MarkInitialized
methods.description: Marks the sequence lock as initialized, allowing it to be used for synchronization.

methods.name: TryRead
methods.description: Attempts to read data protected by the sequence lock without blocking, returning false if the lock is uninitialized or a concurrent write occurs.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Performs a write operation on the protected data, updating the sequence counter to indicate a write in progress.

methods.name: ModificationCount
methods.description: Returns the number of times the lock has been written to, for tracking modifications.

methods.name: IncrementModificationCount
methods.description: Increments the modification count, indicating a new write.
